name: NEXO (Hyundai Motor hydrogen car brand)
verdict: NEXO is Hyundai Motor Company's hydrogen-car brand; Hyundai Motor Group is a listed, family-controlled group, and South Korea's National Pension Service holding about 7.8% of Hyundai Motor is not a link to abuse (no record claim for South Korea).
note: Front-of-shirt main sponsor of Jeonbuk Hyundai since the 2025 season ('La Decima' 2026 kit: NEXO wordmark over the HYUNDAI mark; visible in the club's 2026 launch images). Replaced the N brand, which was the front sponsor 2019-2024.
